models.label: Kaggle baseline · one-shot
models.description: Compact 64×64 CNN trained on Kaggle. Fastest option; classifies each square independently and does not create appearance groups.

models.label: DINOv2 grouped · Kaggle trained
models.description: Production DINOv2 model trained on 90% of Kaggle plus the website's Unicode preview theme, with complete-linkage grouping at threshold 0.95. Best same-distribution accuracy; not an unseen-theme benchmark.

models.label: DINOv2 grouped · no Kaggle training
models.description: DINOv2 grouping trained only on generated chess themes. Use this option to explore transfer to themes absent from chess-specific training.
